Bid Summary.value: Dallas Independent School District is seeking to purchase one of each of the following items: a Tier 1 Small Student Chromebook Laptop (Touch), a Tier 2 Large Student Chromebook Laptop (Non-Touch), a Tier 3 Student Windows Laptop, a Student Tablet, a Tier 1 Staff Basic Desktop, a Tier 2 Staff Professional Desktop, a Tier 1 Staff Laptop, a Tier 2 Staff Laptop, a Display Monitor – Touch, a Display Monitor – Non-Touch, an Additional Warranty, a Device Deployment, and Subscriptions/Services Required. Bids must be submitted electronically through the iSupplier portal (https://www.dallasisd.org/domain/143) or as a sealed hard copy delivered to Procurement Services by July 9, 2024, 2:00 PM CDT; fax or email submissions are not accepted. The proposal must include a signed acknowledgement of this addendum, MWBE Forms, a W-9 Form, optional Punch-Out Process documentation, a 1295 form, and non-warranty options as an attachment; delivery must involve white-glove services, asset decaling, reporting, etching, and coordination with the ED Tech department, and the contract will be issued under the EPCNT and CTPA cooperatives. The initial term of the contract is three years with up to two one-year renewals, for a maximum total of five years. Bid bond, payment terms, product specifications, model numbers, and part numbers are not specified in the bid.
